topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture, connects it to prior practicals, and outlines the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor viruses and experimental assays for cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of tumor viruses revealed that cancer arises from altered cellular genes and describe the experimental assays used to demonstrate cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenes and tumor suppressors are defined and how their mutations functionally disrupt cellular controls such as the cell cycle.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability in cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how defects in DNA repair, replication, and mitosis generate genomic instability to drive multi-step cancer progression.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes and tumor maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how inherited germline mutations accelerate tumor development and analyze the role of genomic instability in tumor maintenance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a reading recommendation and a preview of the next session.
